title: 吊り下げ看板（無地）
description: 店先の壁から張り出す、鍛鉄の腕金に吊るした看板です。壁の取付板と背板、腕金と渦巻き飾りの支え、吊り輪、深緑の看板板と金色の縁を造形しています。板面は店名やロゴのない無地で、揺れの動作や壁への固定金具の内部は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.120 × 0.685 × 0.930 m、2,548三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A projecting shop sign hung from a wrought-iron bracket. It models the wall mounting plate and backplate, bracket arm with scrolled brace, hanger rings, and a deep-green board with gilded edge mouldings. The board is blank without shop names or logos; swinging motion and concealed wall fixings are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.120 × 0.685 × 0.930 m; 2,548 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
